section1.title: Gabriel Fernandes de Carvalho
section1.subtitle: Backend Developer with experience in Laravel, NodeJS, Python, .NET, PHP and Java
section1.intro: Scroll to discover my skills and projects
section1.bio: I've been coding back-end for years using Laravel, Node.js, Python, .NET, and Java — but the stack is just a tool. What matters is solving real problems. At Fábrica de Tecnologias Turing (UniEVANGÉLICA), I coordinate systems serving thousands of users daily. I've collaborated with the Brazilian Air Force on critical projects and maintain academic repositories that became references.

summary.title: Professional summary
summary.paragraph1: My main focus is backend engineering and building institutional systems. I work with Laravel/PHP, Node.js/TypeScript, and Java/Spring Boot, using PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and other technologies depending on each solution's requirements.
summary.paragraph2: I build REST APIs, system integrations, authentication, access control, auditing, queues, and asynchronous processing. I also work on frontend applications with Vue.js and React when a project calls for full-stack work.
summary.paragraph3: My experience includes academic systems, research platforms, editorial solutions, automations, and institutional applications built for UniEVANGÉLICA, Fábrica de Tecnologias Turing, and the Brazilian Air Force. I have a growing interest in software architecture, cloud, observability, security, and applied AI for business systems.

aila.title: Aila — Smart Peer Reviewer Recommendation
aila.impact: Supports the selection of scientific peer reviewers through ranking, editorial history, and recurrence analysis, reducing reliance on manual searches during the review process.
aila.roleShort: I built the whole system on my own: a Python/FastAPI backend with local-AI classification, reviewer ranking and invitation history, plus the Nuxt/Vue frontend.
aila.result: Structured ranking of reviewers matched to manuscripts, with recurrence and invitation history.

maximiza.title: Maximiza Seguros
maximiza.impact: Institutional platform for an insurance brokerage, with a solutions catalog, integrated forms, and corporate content published in production.
maximiza.roleShort: I evolved the interface, integrated forms and institutional pages, and handled performance and technical SEO through to production.
maximiza.result: Site in production supporting Maximiza Seguros' commercial strategy.

fronteiras.title: Editorial Automation — Revista Fronteiras
fronteiras.impact: Automation that unblocked a real backlog of scientific submissions stuck for over a year in an OJS editorial system.
fronteiras.roleShort: I built the entire automation on my own, covering submission lookup, participant assignment, and executive report generation.
fronteiras.result: Dozens of real submissions unblocked, evidenced by execution reports and logs.

esports.title: E-Sports UniEVANGÉLICA Portal — 5th edition
esports.impact: Tournament registration and management system with versioned editions, allowing the 4th edition to be archived and the 5th launched without losing public history.
esports.roleShort: Lead author of both backend and frontend, including the versioned-edition system and the backend's security layer.
esports.result: 5th edition published with a versioned-edition system, preserving the 4th edition's history.

jac.title: JAC – Academic and Community Journey
jac.impact: Academic event management system with QR-code and geolocation check-in, and gamified point rewards. An advanced personal project, with 100+ automated tests.
jac.roleShort: I built the entire architecture (backend and frontend), the geospatial and QR-code check-in, and drove documented remediation of security vulnerabilities.
jac.result: Backend and frontend with automated tests and deploy pipelines configured across multiple platforms.

lionFanstone.title: Lion — James Fanstone System Rewrite
lionFanstone.impact: Backend rewrite of an institutional academic-research platform, migrating from a legacy production system to a new Java/Spring Boot architecture.
lionFanstone.roleShort: I'm solely leading the backend's architectural rewrite, with real CNPq/Lattes integration. Still in development, not yet published to production.
lionFanstone.result: Rewrite in progress with full ownership, CI configured, and automated tests.
